samples.question: A reference pair of stacked horizontal bars is shown in the top panel. Below it, the image is split into four quadrants, each containing one pair of stacked horizontal bars. The vertical gap is the empty space between the lower edge of the top bar and the upper edge of the bottom bar of a pair. Exactly one quadrant's bar pair has the same vertical gap as the reference pair. Which quadrant contains the bar pair whose gap matches the reference pair?
